title: Machine Learning
description: A map of the assumptions that let machines improve from experience.

content.text: Machine learning changes how we write programs: we describe experience, an objective, and constraints, then let a model discover a useful mapping.
Every learning system has data, a model class, and a loss function. The interesting work is often in the seams between them.

content.title: Working definition
content.text: Learning is controlled improvement against an objective, under assumptions that should be made visible.
